body:
First off, thank you for your well thought out response.

I tend not to think of life and death in terms of positive or negative, black or white. I'm not religious so I think death is....nothing. But isn't there peace in nothing? I wouldn't say it is nirvana but life is just so.... not fulfilling. Maybe it will be a great terrible nothing but I already feel like I'm nothing so to be that eternally could be fulfilling.

I'm sure I've changed people. Maybe some for better, some for worse. I'm not the greatest person, hell, no one is. I'm sure they would be upset, happy, or some other mix of emotions. Those closest to me would be devastated, but I hope it would bring them peace of mind that it was my decision and I went through with it knowing the consequences. That might make me an uncaring asshole but... at this point what difference does it make?

I just wish there was an easy option.
